decision_notes: This gate intentionally blocks production J jobs until a representative set has been calculated and reviewed.
Each result must bind input/output files and SHA-256 hashes for both methods.
The benchmark must cover representative H-H, H-F/F-C and H-P/P-C couplings when those classes occur in the 52-compound set.
F3_006 iodine is not covered by this generic gate and additionally requires the dedicated iodine/X2C gate.
